text:
### What They'll Do  
The Ombudsman will:
- Review your complaint independently
- Contact FirstUK for additional information
- Issue a decision (binding on us, non-binding on you)
- Make an award (compensation) if they agree with you
- Handle everything FREE of charge  
**Timeline:** Typically 3–6 months

raw_entities.name: Financial Ombudsman Service
raw_entities.description: Independent external authority responsible for reviewing customer complaints against FirstUK. The Ombudsman reviews complaints independently, contacts FirstUK for additional information, issues binding decisions on the bank, and awards compensation if the customer's complaint is upheld. Services are provided free of charge to customers.
context: The Ombudsman will: Review your complaint independently
Contact FirstUK for additional information
Issue a decision (binding on us, non-binding on you)
Make an award (compensation) if they agree with you
Handle everything FREE of charge

raw_entities.name: Complaint Resolution through Ombudsman
raw_entities.description: The external complaint resolution process managed by the Financial Ombudsman Service. This process handles customer complaints that have not been resolved through internal bank procedures. The Ombudsman conducts an independent review, gathers information from FirstUK, and issues a binding decision on the bank with potential compensation awards.
context: The Ombudsman will: Review your complaint independently
Contact FirstUK for additional information
Issue a decision (binding on us, non-binding on you)
Timeline: Typically 3–6 months

raw_entities.name: Independent Complaint Review
raw_entities.description: The Ombudsman's initial step to independently review the customer's complaint without bias or influence from FirstUK. This forms the foundation of the external complaint resolution process.
context: Review your complaint independently

raw_entities.name: Information Request from FirstUK
raw_entities.description: The Ombudsman contacts FirstUK to obtain additional information, documentation, and context necessary to make an informed decision on the complaint.
context: Contact FirstUK for additional information

raw_entities.name: Ombudsman Decision Issuance
raw_entities.description: The Ombudsman issues a formal decision on the complaint. The decision is binding on FirstUK but non-binding on the customer, who retains the right to pursue other remedies if dissatisfied.
context: Issue a decision (binding on us, non-binding on you)

raw_entities.name: Compensation Award
raw_entities.description: If the Ombudsman upholds the customer's complaint, they make a compensation award. The amount and terms are determined based on the merits of the complaint and applicable Ombudsman guidelines.
context: Make an award (compensation) if they agree with you

raw_entities.name: Complaint Customer
raw_entities.description: The customer who has filed a complaint with the Financial Ombudsman Service against FirstUK. The customer receives a non-binding decision from the Ombudsman and may receive compensation if their complaint is upheld.
context: Review your complaint independently
Issue a decision (binding on us, non-binding on you)
Make an award (compensation) if they agree with you
